n281a8cb44f.headline: How new US sanctions will affect Russia
n281a8cb44f.summary: U.S. sanctions target Russian companies to deprive them of international partners, potentially impacting their global operations and financing.
n281a8cb44f.why: Sanctions can restrict access to capital and markets for targeted companies, affecting Russia's economy and global trade relations.
n281a8cb44f.why_moved: The sanctions increase operational and financial risks for Russian companies, affecting investor sentiment.

n36de828570.headline: AUD/USD and NZD/USD Fundamental Weekly Forecast – NZ Employment Change Expected to Show Improvement
n36de828570.summary: The Australian dollar declined against the U.S. dollar after a weaker-than-expected quarterly consumer inflation report, with CPI at 0.6% versus an estimate of 0.8%.
n36de828570.why: Inflation data influences central bank policy expectations and currency valuations, affecting trade and investment flows.

impacts.name: Australian Dollar
impacts.why: Lower inflation reduces expectations for rate hikes, weakening the currency.
